source.step14_decision_gate: STEP 14 COMPLETE — STRONG V2 CHALLENGER IDENTIFIED

selection_rule: Prioritize BOTH Grid+Iron Fly targets with positive TEST BSS, validation support, walk-forward support, and strategy relevance.
Use path_inside_70 as the authoritative containment probability and derive range_breached as complement to avoid contradictory duplicate probabilities.
Keep directional/excursion outputs only as secondary or defensive context.
Do not include rejected weak targets: mean_reversion, trend_continuation, one_sided_runaway, trend_efficiency_high.

abstention_policy.unsupported_target_horizon: Return NO_RELIABLE_FORECAST when target/horizon is absent from the frozen manifest or derived outputs.
abstention_policy.feature_missing_after_warmup: Return NO_RELIABLE_FORECAST if any required model feature is missing after the Step 13 warmup window.
abstention_policy.asof_violation: Return NO_RELIABLE_FORECAST if any feature source timestamp is later than prediction timestamp.
abstention_policy.unsupported_regime: Return probability with LOW quality or abstain if regime was unseen or had insufficient Step 14 support.
abstention_policy.ood: Return probability with LOW quality or abstain if OOD policy flags severe feature distribution drift.

ood_policy.feature_range_rule: Flag OOD if any continuous feature lies outside the Step 13 training min/max with a 5% tolerance or outside p01/p99 for three or more required features.
ood_policy.binary_state_rule: Flag OOD if an interaction state cannot be computed due to missing constituent or threshold state.
ood_policy.regime_rule: Flag OOD/LOW quality for unseen regime values.
ood_policy.action: Do not alter probability numerically; attach quality flag LOW or abstain for severe OOD.

quality_policy.HIGH: Strong TEST BSS/AUC/calibration and walk-forward support.
quality_policy.MEDIUM: Positive TEST BSS, acceptable ranking/calibration, and walk-forward support.
quality_policy.LOW: Positive but weaker evidence; shadow only.
quality_policy.RESEARCH_ONLY: Do not expose as candidate V2 output.
